blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Have you ever visited Atabay Peak in Barangay Marmol, Tuburan, Cebu? The Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (TIEZA) is pushing to build a suspension bridge in the area as part of its development plans for the mountain getaway in midwestern Cebu. TIEZA Chief Operating Officer Mark Lapid said the suspension bridge, proposed by the local government and former Mayor Aljun Diamante, is just one of the facilities being planned for the area, which is emerging as a nature tourism destination in this part of the island province.
